description:
For a BUSINESS that wants to offer its own services through the Multiservicios affiliate network — not for a customer looking for a service (use request_service) and not for someone who wants to refer customers as an affiliate. It sends an application that a person reviews; it does not list the business, promise approval, or create any service.

Ask for the business name, a contact name, email, phone, the kind of service, the US states where it is offered and a short description. Ask for consent in the person's own words — "is it alright if Multiservicios contacts you about this?" — and send `consent: true` only once they have said so. No document, ID number or immigration status is asked for or accepted.

A successful call comes back with `status: "received"`. Do not send it again.

business_name.description: The business's name, as its owner writes it.

category.description: The closest kind of service. Use `other` when nothing fits.

consent.description: The person has said, in their own words, that Multiservicios may contact them about this application. Ask them; never assume it.

contact_name.description: Who we should talk to about the application.

description.description: What the business offers, to whom, and in which languages — in its own words.

email.description: Where we write back about the application.

locale.description: The language the person is writing in. The reply comes back in it.

phone.description: A number to reach the contact, as they write it.

states.description: Two-letter codes of the US states where the business offers the service.

website.description: The business's website, if it has one.

name: apply_as_provider

message.description: What to tell the person, in their language.

title: Apply for a business to sell its services through Multiservicios
